# Let users undo an accidental draft discard

## What & Why
Discard is intentional, but users can still click it by mistake. A short-lived recovery option would prevent useful unsaved work from being lost while preserving the current discard behavior.

## Done looks like
- Discarded answer and opportunity drafts can be recovered for a clearly defined short window.
- Recovery restores the correct form and content without saving it automatically.
- The recovery affordance and its outcome are announced to assistive technology users.
